note: The questions here are written for this app from each course's published syllabus. They are not the courses' own exam questions. The readiness figure only says how you are doing on this bank.

certs.name: Introduction to Machine Learning
facts: The final score is 25% from weekly assignments and 75% from a three-hour proctored exam.
A certificate needs at least 10 of 25 on assignments, 30 of 75 on the exam, and 40 overall.
In a 12-week course the best 8 of the 12 assignments count.
One third-party guide describes the paper as 100 one-mark multiple-choice questions with no negative marking. Papers vary by course, so check your course's own announcement.

certs.name: Machine Learning Specialization
certs.by: DeepLearning.AI and Stanford Online, on Coursera
facts: Three courses: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification; Advanced Learning Algorithms; Unsupervised Learning, Recommenders, Reinforcement Learning.
Taught by Andrew Ng. About 95 hours in total, at beginner level.
Assessed by graded programming assignments in Python. The certificate needs paid enrolment; auditing does not earn one.
The Build stages 1 and 2 and the ML coding list cover the same ground by hand, which is the harder version of those assignments.

certs.name: Deep Learning Specialization
facts: Five courses: Neural Networks and Deep Learning; Improving Deep Neural Networks; Structuring Machine Learning Projects; Convolutional Neural Networks; Sequence Models.
Taught by Andrew Ng. Intermediate level, with Python expected.
Assessed by auto-graded programming assignments in Python and TensorFlow.
Stages 2 to 4 of the Build cover the first, second and fifth courses by hand.

others.name: Stanford CS336: Language Modeling from Scratch
others.note: No certificate. The Spring 2026 lectures and all five assignments are public. Assignment 1 asks for a tokenizer, a Transformer, an optimizer and a trained model, which is Stage 4 of the Build. Use it as the harder second pass.

others.name: Andrej Karpathy: Neural Networks, Zero to Hero
others.note: No certificate. It is the model for the Build: every piece written from scratch, in order, with nothing hidden.
